title: The Thief's Stone
journal: Never-Writes-Twice sent me after the three seal-stones. A dead thief's stone lies in the warden's vault at Blackrose Prison, whose people, the Blackguards' heirs, attack strangers on sight. Their gate-captain stands outside the gate. I'm to get in: as a guest past the gate-captain (a toll, words or a duel), unseen past the walls, or by force.
objectives: Get into Blackrose Prison; the gate-captain stands at the gate. (marker: Corvus Ulvius, Blackrose Prison)

plan.going: I am a Reel-Ka of the Toh-Reel-Ka, hunting the three seal-stones that open the kings' gate at Teku-Sul before the Unbound get them. One lies in the warden's vault in Blackrose Prison. The prison's people attack strangers.
plan.next: get into the prison; the gate-captain outside the gate is the first person to deal with
plan.ways: pay the gate-captain 300 gold, persuade him (Speech 75) or duel him until he yields: each makes me a guest, and the garrison stops attacking me; or slip past the walls unseen (Sneak, Invisibility), and they attack if they see me; or fight my way in (any fighting skill), and the whole garrison fights me

answers: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka. Never-Writes-Twice ordered me to take three seal-stones to open the gate at Teku-Sul Spire, where the Eye of Argonia lies, so I can heal the sick Hist trees before the Unbound get them. One stone is a dead thief stone in the warden vault at Blackrose Prison.
Get into Blackrose Prison, starting with the gate-captain Corvus Ulvius outside the gate, then reach the warden vault in Raj-Kaal Okaz-Teel hall.

Get in as a guest by paying 300 gold, persuading him with words, or a duel with him. Or climb the walls unseen, or use force, though killing him means fighting the whole Rose. He also says Okaz-Teel has the vault key on his belt and an Imperial in the hall has a buyer for what is inside.
I do not understand what exactly the seal-stone is, or who the Imperial buyer is exactly (Ennodius Vanin seems to be here). I could find out by talking to people inside.

title: The Thief's Stone
journal: Corvus Ulvius let me through the gate as a guest, and the Blackguards' heirs will not attack me now. The vault's key is on Okaz-Teel, the Naga raj-kaal in his hall. I'm to get the stone: buy the key from him for 1,000 gold, lift it from his belt, or pick the vault's lock at night when the hall is quiet. A theft that is seen turns the garrison on me.
objectives: Take the seal-stone from the Warden's Vault in Okaz-Teel's hall. (marker: Door to Warden's Vault, Okaz-Teel)

plan.going: I am inside as a guest; the garrison does not attack me
plan.next: get the stone from the warden's vault in Okaz-Teel's hall
plan.ways: buy the key from Okaz-Teel for 1,000 gold; pickpocket it from him; pick the Expert lock at night; any theft seen turns the garrison on me. The Collector is here too: I can talk to him, lift his ring (hard), kill him for it (losing his side errand) or leave him

answers: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka and must collect three seal-stones to open the gate at Teku-Sul Spire before the Unbound do. I paid Corvus 300 gold and am now a guest at Blackrose; the heirs will not attack me.
Get the seal-stone from the Warden Vault in Okaz-Teel hall.
Buy the key from Okaz-Teel for 1,000 gold, lift it from his belt (a seen theft turns the garrison on me), or pick the vault lock at night when the hall is quiet.
I do not know what the seal-stone really is, or what Ennodius Vanin intends. I can ask Okaz-Teel and Vanin.
